notes.title: New Devlog + Kickstarter LAST 48h!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-taming]Synth Beasts' Kickstarter campaign[/url] has been running for almost a month now, and we're almost in the final 48h!  

I wanted to make this video to remind you all about it in case you wanted to back for some of the exclusive rewards, which include:
[list]
[*] [b]Design a Boss ➜ [/b]Create its look, mechanics, and backstory.
[*] [b]Build an Island ➜[/b] Craft a whole explorable area with lore, puzzles, and combat.
[*] [b]Create a Synth Beast ➜[/b] Bring your own playable monster to life.
[*] [b]Make a Gizmo ➜[/b] Invent an equippable item that alters creature abilities, inspired by Hollow Knight’s Charm system.
[*] [b]Build a Statue ➜[/b] Immortalise yourself on the Hero’s Isle with custom visuals and an inscription.
[*] [b]Form an NPC ➜[/b] Bring yourself to life as one of the game's scientists! You get to decide what the NPC says!
[*] [b]Message in a Bottle ➜[/b] Leave riddles, secrets, or heartfelt notes for players to discover.
[/list]

Other than that, I just published a new YouTube video which covers the behind the scenes of creating Synth Beasts' recurring rival battle! If that interests you, give it a watch below!

[previewyoutube=BPb6qOXWG54;full][/previewyoutube]

If Synth Beasts sounds like your kind of game, make sure to back it here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-tamin]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-tamin[/url]g ! 

Anyways, that's it for this update, and see you soon :)

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: Demo OUT NOW + Crowdfunding RELEASE!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

4 months ago I announced that Synth Beasts would be coming to Kickstarter, and... I'm excited to announce that it has [b]JUST LAUNCHED[/b]! [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-taming]Check out the campaign here[/url].

It's a [b]Monster Taming Action RPG[/b], so think [b]Pokemon with real-time combat[/b] and a Metroidvania-inspired open world. [b]It's also got a free demo here on Steam[/b], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421080/Synth_Beasts/]so go check it out on the store page[/url]! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090564/5d3e6a969ff277ac8707992a0eac547c08270c9f.png[/img]

There are [b]2 main reasons [/b]I decided to bring Synth Beasts to Kickstarter:

[list]
[*] Firstly, while the game's core development is almost done, I want to bring it to [b]as many platforms as possible[/b]. With Soul Stalker, we initially planned to only bring it to Steam and Switch, but [b]because of our awesome porting partners at Origami Panda Studio[/b], we were also able to bring it to Xbox and PlayStation! Now that we have experience doing all of this, I wanted to continue doing so with Synth Beasts, and [b]the Kickstarter make this possible[/b]!
[*] Secondly, [b]I absolutely loved involving the community[/b] in our previous games' development. Some of the best items, characters, and monsters were all designed by you guys through the creative backer tiers, and [b]Synth Beasts is doubling down[/b] on that.

[/list]

Some of Synth Beasts' creative tiers include:

[list]
[*] [b]Design a Boss ➜ [/b]Create its look, mechanics, and backstory.
[*] [b]Build an Island ➜[/b] Craft a whole explorable area with lore, puzzles, and combat.
[*] [b]Create a Synth Beast ➜[/b] Bring your own playable monster to life.
[*] [b]Make a Gizmo ➜[/b] Invent an equippable item that alters creature abilities, inspired by Hollow Knight’s Charm system.
[*] [b]Build a Statue ➜[/b] Immortalise yourself on the Hero’s Isle with custom visuals and an inscription.
[*] [b]Form an NPC ➜[/b] Bring yourself to life as one of the game's scientists! You get to decide what the NPC says!
[*] [b]Message in a Bottle ➜[/b] Leave riddles, secrets, or heartfelt notes for players to discover.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090564/2bae74242d2d6c1a353fa5e0e8eb485066adffc5.gif[/img]

If Synth Beasts sounds like your kind of game, make sure to back it here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-tamin]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-tamin[/url]g ! 

Anyways, that's it for this update, and see you soon :)

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: Synth Beasts Campaign Date ANNOUNCE!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

A few months ago I announced that I'd be running a Kickstarter campaign to fund the final stretch of Synth Beasts development. I'm now super excited to announce that the campaign will launch on the [b][u]7th of May[/u][/b]! If you want to follow the Kickstarter campaign to get notified when it comes out, make sure to [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-taming]click here[/url]!

The campaign will have rewards such as allowing backers to make their own monsters, build their own small islands, and design their own boss! Some tiers also give access to a pre-launch beta that allows backers to influence the final balance of the game, and game keys will be available for Steam and console!

Lastly, the Kickstarter will come with a free ~1h long demo on Steam, and you can watch a video going over its development in full below!

[previewyoutube=Rc2o13IBkp8;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyways, that's it for this update, and I hope you all enjoyed the video and news! If you want to support Synth Beasts, another great way in which you can do that is through wishlisting the game on Steam :)

See you all soon!

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: Synth Beasts is Evolving!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a while since we've updated you all on the state of Synth Beasts, but I'm happy to announce that the game has seen many incredible improvements over the past few months, and have several announcements to make relating to them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090564/2bae74242d2d6c1a353fa5e0e8eb485066adffc5.gif[/img]

I've made a video that you can find below going over them all, so make sure to watch it if you want to stay up to date, but the most important takeaway from it if you want to keep up with the development side of things as closely as possible is that we're going to be running [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-taming]a Kickstarter campaign for the game[/url]! This is for two main reasons:
[list]
[*] Firstly, we want to help fund a part of the console ports so that we can make sure to simultaneously launch on all platforms.

[*] Our second reason is that I personally love involving a game's community as much as possible, and allowing players to leave their mark. With Synth Beasts, we plan on having tons of awesome backer rewards such as making your own monsters, making your own islands, and way way more. Of course, if you just want to support us by getting the game through Kickstarter, you'll be able to get a key for any of the supported platforms!
[/list]
If you want to follow the Kickstarter so that you don't miss out,[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/radhood/synth-beasts-action-rpg-monster-taming] click here[/url]. And if you want to know what the recent improvements are, give the video below a watch!

[previewyoutube=E_JLItbVLcA;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyways, that's it for this update, and I'm looking forward to sharing more Synth Beasts news very soon!

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: New Halloween Game From Our Studio OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A while ago we announced another game, Wanted Shadows, which is a more action-heavy take on the same genre that Soul Stalker is in. Well, the game is OUT NOW![u][b] If you own our other game Soul Stalker, you'll get a 10% discount[/b][/u], and there's a [b]limited time launch discount as well[/b] so make sure to get it now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491670/Wanted_Shadows/

Here are some key stats of the game so that you know what to expect:

[list]
[*] Costs [u][b]$1.49 [/b][/u]USD (seriously!). 
[*] ~10 hours of gameplay.
[*] 140 in-run upgrades.
[*] 5 characters.
[*] 6 weapons.
[*] 17 equippable powers.
[*] 36 achievements.
[*] 3 levels.
[*] 3 ascensions per level.
[/list]

Our aim with this new game was to make it the most action-based and engaging Bullet Heaven, as well as providing a[b] crazy amount of bang for your buck[/b] (hence the low price)! We don't work with a publisher that takes a large percentage cut, so this is the reason we can pass on the savings to you! I've also made a video about the whole development process of the game, so check it out if it interests you:

[previewyoutube=oqwp39I98NA;full][/previewyoutube]

Another bonus is that the universe of Wanted Shadows is the same as Synth Beasts', so if you want to learn more about the world we've created, get the game!

That's it for this update, make sure to review both Wanted Shadows and Soul Stalker on Steam as it helps us so much, and I hope you have a great time!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491670/Wanted_Shadows/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: Our Other Game Is OUT NOW!!! (Launch Discount)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

While we're working on Synth Beasts, we also have another game under development, Soul Stalker... And I'm so excited to announce that [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/]Soul Stalker is OUT NOW[/url]!!! We've added a [b]10% launch discount[/b] for the first week so make sure to get it while it lasts! Also, make sure to[u][b] review the game[/b][/u], it helps so much!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/

You'll also see that[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/] the Steam page has bundles[/url] with [b]Spellbook Demonslayers[/b] and[b] Star Survivor[/b] so you can get Soul Stalker together with one of those on a discount! What's even cooler is that [b]if you already own one of them you get the discount on Soul Stalker anyways[/b]!

While this is a big milestone for the game,[b] it's only the beginning[/b]. We're going to be making radical additions to Soul Stalker throughout Early Access, and [b]take the community's suggestions wherever we can[/b]! We want to wait until we get initial feedback in the first couple of days of release until we make any announcements so that we can [b]develop in the direction the community desires[/b], but we have some pretty cool stuff planned already ;)

If you want to be a part of the quick iterations, make sure to [url=https://discord.gg/enfBJjdUmJ]join our Discord server[/url] as I'll be posting constant updates! 

See you soon, and I hope you all enjoy the game! A [u][b]review[/b][/u] if you like it would also help a ton :)

- Conrad, Lead Developer
